# setup

Bulk TCRβ trajectories of the PBLs coloured by the single-cell phenotype of each clonotype. Runs after the
single-cell analysis: it reads the per-timepoint phenotype tables written by `m03-plots-analyses.Rmd`.

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(scales)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(grid)
  library(readxl)
})
setup_dir <- normalizePath("../setup", mustWork = TRUE)
project_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(setup_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(setup_dir, "functions-long-tracking.R"))
source(file.path(setup_dir, "colors.R"))
```

# data

```{r, warning=FALSE}
load_data(samples = "blood",
          datapath.pbl = file.path(project_dir, "data", "bulk-tcrb"),
          output.list.name = "pbl",
          technology = "adaptive",
          min_freq = 1e-3
)
# --- Loaders name elements after their folder; the script uses the patient name ---
names(pbl) <- "RIO136"
```

# traj x pheno

```{r}
# --- Parameters ---
patient <- "RIO136"
# --- CD8+ non-naive integrated object, the only compartment annotated by m03 ---
bulk_comp <- "cd8_int_nn"
times <- c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6")
# --- Tables from m03-plots-analyses.Rmd; manual_colors from setup/colors.R ---
annot_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "results", "single-cell", "integrated",
                       "phenotype-trajectories", "tables")
out_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "results", "long-tracking", "phenotype-trajectories")
plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots")
table_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
# --- Bulk trajectories coloured by single-cell phenotype, one per timepoint ---
bulk_trajectories <- list()
for (time in times) {
  annotation <- read.delim(
    file.path(
      annot_dir,
      paste0("Single-cell_", bulk_comp, "_", time, ".tsv")
    ),
    sep = "\t",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  bulk_result <- plot_annotated_bulk_trajectories(
    patient_list = pbl[[patient]],
    annotation = annotation,
    time = time,
    manual_colors = manual_colors,
    compartment = bulk_comp,
    plot_dir = plot_dir,
    table_dir = table_dir,
    output_prefix = paste0("Deep_sequencing_", bulk_comp, "_", time),
    floor_y = 1e-3
  )
  bulk_trajectories[[time]] <- bulk_result$data
  print(bulk_result$plot)
}
rm(time, annotation, bulk_result)
```
